description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kaduwaskaduwa, Panadura D/S Division, Kalutara District
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically the registration of title for intestate properties under the Registration of Title Act. It contains notices calling for claims to properties of deceased individuals, detailed land descriptions including cadastral map numbers, parcel numbers, and land extents. The content focuses on land title settlement procedures and property ownership claims, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily concerns land registration and property transfer matters.
